business_model.v: Online poker and real-money gaming platform

company.status: Defunct — halted real-money online gaming operations Aug 2025 after Online Gaming Bill; laid off 50% of workforce (200 employees) Sep 2025; shut down free-to-play subscription social poker app

description.v: Kolkata-based online poker platform, founded in 2014 by Navkiran Singh; registered as Baazi Networks Private Limited

locations.address_or_area: 13-H, Ground Floor, S.N. Chatterjee Road, Kolkata, West Bengal - 700038

conflicts.claim_a: Registered office in Kolkata per MCA/ZaubaCorp
conflicts.claim_b: Office in Chhatarpur, New Delhi per NextOffice
conflicts.resolution: Registered office is Kolkata; operational office also in New Delhi
